text:
sarah: Quick sync — we're bundling partner IaC patterns for cloud marketplaces (AWS/GCP/Azure). Want a mandatory lint + test baseline before we accept partner PRs. My proposal: terraform >=1.4, tflint + checks for module best-practices, checkov for security, terratest + a tiny acceptance smoke test in GH Actions. Also require an examples/ folder with a minimal deploy. Thoughts?

dan: +1 on terratest. Can we standardize on a small contract test that asserts: plan succeeds, resources created, outputs exist? Keep runtime <10m so PR CI isn't flaky.

maria: Love the contract tests. Also suggest we enforce a module interface: inputs for region, instance_type, tags, and outputs for endpoint, role_arn. That makes downstream wiring predictable for partners.

kevin: We should add state handling guidance (remote backend + locking) in the template. And document provider pinning for reproducible CI (eg provider constraints in provider.tf). For Azure/GCP we can include provider stubs in examples.

sarah: Agreed. Drafting a checklist — adding it here so folks can comment: 
- terraform required_version set
- tflint + .tflint.hcl committed
- checkov config (allowlist exceptions documented)
- terratest smoke under tests/ with github workflow that runs on PRs
- examples/minimal with README and expected outputs
- ci uses ephemeral creds and cleans up resources

Here's a tiny GH Actions snippet I'm planning to include in the repo README: 
```yaml
name: PR IaC checks
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
        with:
          terraform_version: '1.4.6'
      - name: terraform init + validate
        run: |
          terraform init -input=false
          terraform validate
      - name: run tflint
        run: tflint --module
      - name: run checkov
        run: checkov -d .
  smoke-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate
    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: run terratest smoke (short)
        run: go test ./tests -run TestSmoke -timeout 10m
```

dan: That looks good. Two notes: 1) add a lightweight mock step for OSS contributors (skip cloud creds) so PRs from forks still get linting. 2) include a tflint-github-action so we get annotations.

maria: We'll also need release rules: semver for modules, changelog in CHANGELOG.md, and a partner label that triggers marketplace packaging. Example: label `partner:marketplace-ready`.

kevin: For packaging, we'll automate the artifact creation in a `release` workflow that builds a tarball + registry metadata. Partner onboarding team will need an approved checklist before we publish. Also note quota/cost estimate in examples so partners don't surprise themselves during CI.

sarah: Nice. I'll update the partner-iac-patterns repo with: templates/, tests/, docs/packaging.md, and a sample .github/workflows/pr_checks.yml. Putting draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-iac-patterns — please add comments directly.

maria: timeline sounds good. I can do a quick partner-facing doc for the marketplace checklist (will include the required outputs and security notes).

sarah: Thanks — aiming to have PR template + initial tests up by EOD Friday. Ping me if you need any scaffolding (I can drop a seed module). :rocket:
